subject: Co-sell onboarding voucher request — RailStream POC
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@cloudforge.co>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Voucher request for RailStream POC (co-sell onboarding)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the intro last week. We're launching a 6-week POC with RailStream (edge analytics for rail networks) and their engineering lead James asked if CloudForge could secure a co-sell onboarding voucher from Redwood to help get them started on GPUs for a live test.

Details:
- Prospect: RailStream (early-stage, Series A)
- POC scope: model-runs + embeddings for anomaly detection, ~5M tokens estimated over 6 weeks
- Request: $10,000 USD credit applied to RailStream account or a marketplace voucher that Redeemable by 2027-06-30
- Outcome we expect: production-ready evaluation with benchmarked latency and cost per query; CloudForge co-sell motion after POC

Attaching CloudForge voucher request form and RailStream intro deck. Can you advise next steps and timeline for approvals? If easier, we can join a quick call today.

[attachment: cloudforge_voucher_railstream.pdf]

Appreciate it —
Amy Chen
Partnerships, CloudForge Accelerator
amy@cloudforge.co | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Amy Chen <amy@cloudforge.co>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Voucher request for RailStream POC (co-sell onboarding)

Hi Amy —

Thanks for the details and the deck, this looks promising. I can start the internal approval flow — a couple quick asks so I can scope the credit correctly:

1) Can you confirm who will be billed/own the Redwood account during the POC (RailStream or CloudForge on behalf)?
2) Do you have a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can attach that shows milestones and who owns each deliverable?
3) Any security/compliance needs (SOC-2 evidence, VPC/network restrictions) beyond standard marketplace controls?

Lauren, looping you in for voucher approval guidance and any finance codes we should use. Sean — FYI on co-sell expectation post-POC.

I can hold $10k as a placeholder but will finalize after the answers above. If you want to jump on a 20-min call at 11:30 PT I can get this moving.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199

Hi team —

I reviewed the request and we can approve a $10k onboarding voucher under these conditions:
- Voucher must be redeemed by 2027-06-30 and attached to RailStream's marketplace account (we do not issue one-time rebates).
- CloudForge must provide a MAP with 3 clear milestones (kickoff, mid-POC check-in, final evaluation) and an expected token/cost burn estimate.
- We need a short MOU from legal (standard co-sell MOU) signed before voucher activation. I can share our approval template.
- We will require a one-page post-POC usage report that includes latency and cost per query.

Please use finance code PARTNER-COSELL-2027 for tracking. I'm attaching the internal approval template (credit-approval-template.docx) — fill the highlighted fields and return to me.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Amy —

Thanks — Lauren's conditions are straightforward. Two quick items I captured for the MAP and approvals:
- MAP (example milestones): 1) Kickoff + data transfer (week 0), 2) Midpoint model evaluation & latency tuning (week 3), 3) Final evaluation + co-sell readiness decision (week 6).
- Billing: RailStream will create a marketplace buyer account and redeem the voucher; CloudForge will assist with onboarding.
- Security: RailStream has requested SOC-2 in-scope controls; I confirmed they are fine with standard marketplace evidence.

I've populated the approval template and uploaded a draft MAP to HubSpot under the deal (link below). Can you please: 1) confirm the RailStream account email to attach the voucher, and 2) sign the MOU when legal sends it?

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/COSELL-RAIL-03127

If all good I will route for the final finance sign-off.

Best,
Aditya
